name: Neocis
description: Neocis, Inc. is a medical robotics company founded in 2009 and headquartered in Miami, Florida, USA. The company develops haptic-guided robotic systems for dental implantology and oral surgery, including the first-generation [Yomi](/robot/neocis_yomi) and second-generation [Yomi S](/robot/neocis_yomi_s) platforms.
